name: gocryptfs
description_en: Encrypted overlay filesystem written in Go
readme_excerpt: An encrypted overlay filesystem written in Go. Official website: https://nuetzlich.net/gocryptfs (markdown source). gocryptfs is built on top the excellent go-fuse FUSE library. This project was inspired by EncFS and strives to fix its security issues while providing good performance (benchmarks). For details on the security of gocryptfs see the Security design document.
